responsibility: Implements the GIMPLE pass that recognizes linear if/else-if chains comparing the same integral SSA value and converts them into a switch. It records per-condition case ranges and PHI mappings, verifies side-effect and overlap constraints, uses jump-table/bit-test profitability checks from tree-switch-conversion, and rewrites the CFG by replacing the head condition with a switch while preserving successor PHI semantics and moving statements from removed chain blocks.
